// Positive fixture for surface/src/timing-lint.ts (read by surface/test/timing-lint.test.ts, never run). Every line that
// ends in `//! <pattern>[ <pattern>…]` must give exactly those findings, in that order; every other line gives none.
import { expect, setDefaultTimeout, test } from "bun:test";

const sleep = (ms: number) => Bun.sleep(ms); //! sleep
setDefaultTimeout(1_000); //! test-timeout
jest.setTimeout(250); //! test-timeout

test("fixed sleeps", async () => {
	await Bun.sleep(50); //! sleep
	Bun.sleepSync(5); //! sleep
	await Bun . sleep(1); //! sleep
	await sleep(200); //! sleep
	await delay(10); //! sleep
});

test("timer waits", async () => {
	await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 50)); //! timer
	await new Promise<void>((resolve) => globalThis.setTimeout(resolve, 10)); //! timer
	const watchdog = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 30_000); //! timer
	const poll = setInterval(() => check(), 25); //! timer
	setTimeout(() => sock.end(), 50); //! timer
});

test("timers that are not failure-only watchdogs", async () => {
	const tuned = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), 2_000); //! timer
	const ready = setTimeout(() => resolve(true), 30_000); //! timer
	const flagged = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; child.kill("SIGKILL"); }, 30_000); //! timer
	const untilMs = setTimeout(() => child.kill("SIGKILL"), ms); //! timer
	try {
		await child.exited;
	} finally {
		clearTimeout(tuned);
		clearTimeout(ready);
		clearTimeout(flagged);
		clearTimeout(untilMs);
	}
});

test("deadline races", async () => {
	const timeout = new Promise<false>((r) => setTimeout(() => r(false), 9_000)); //! timer
	const finished = await Promise.race([ended, timeout]); //! race
	const chunk = await Promise.race([next, Bun.sleep(100).then(() => null)]); //! race sleep
	await Promise.race([work, deadlineHit]); //! race
});

test("wall-clock assertions", () => {
	const t0 = Date.now();
	run();
	expect(Date.now() - t0).toBeLessThan(2_000); //! clock-assert
	expect(performance.now() - t0).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(900); //! clock-assert
	expect(Date.parse(lease)).toBeLessThan(Date.now()); //! clock-assert
	expect(Bun.nanoseconds()).toBeGreaterThan(start); //! clock-assert
});

test("elapsed and deadlines", async () => {
	const started = performance.now();
	const elapsed = performance.now() - started; //! clock-elapsed
	const took = Date.now() - (heartbeatAt(w) ?? 0); //! clock-elapsed
	const end = Date.now() + ms;
	while (Date.now() < end) { //! clock-deadline
		if (done()) break;
	}
	if (end <= Date.now()) throw new Error("late"); //! clock-deadline
	const left = deadline - Date.now(); //! clock-deadline
	return Date.now() - since > quietMs; //! clock-elapsed
});

test("a small explicit timeout", async () => { //! test-timeout
	await work();
}, 1_000);

test("a small timeout object", () => { //! test-timeout
	work();
}, { timeout: 250 });

test.each([1, 2])("each %p with a small timeout", (n) => { //! test-timeout
	expect(n).toBeGreaterThan(0);
}, 500);

it("an it() with a small timeout", () => {}, 100); //! test-timeout
